headline: Result Update

highlights: 13 November 2026 CMP*: ₹2,400/- Sector – Book Profit Laurus Labs Ltd – Q2FY27 1 Result Update Q2FY27 Laurus Labs Ltd Important Data During Q2FY27, Laurus Labs reported revenue growth of 33% YoY and 9% QoQ to ₹2,206crs, driven by strong performance in the CDMO business, particularly small molecules, which grew 86% YoY, while Affordable Medicines (Generics) revenue increased 15%.

EBITDA grew 86% YoY and 18% QoQ to ₹750crs, with EBITDA margin expanding to 34% from 24% in Q2FY26 and 31% in Q1FY27, supported by higher commercial supplies, improved capacity utilisation and favourable segment mix.
PAT increased 124% YoY and 20% QoQ to ₹436crs, with PAT margin improving to 20% from 12% in Q2FY26.
For H1FY27, revenue grew 31% to ₹4,233crs, EBITDA increased 77% to ₹1,389crs and PAT rose 124% to ₹798crs.
valuation: It expects business momentum to remain consistent, supported by multiple commercialised programmes and projects at different stages.
Management reiterated its margin targets of gross margin above 60% and EBITDA margin above 30%, along with its ₹3,000crs capex plan for FY27–FY28.
Laurus Labs is currently trading at 96x FY27E and 83x FY28E earnings, with EV/EBITDA multiples of 53x and 46x, respectively.
watch: KRKA JV production is expected to commence around mid- 2027, with meaningful revenue contribution from FY28–FY29. • Margin outlook: Management reiterated its comfort with maintaining gross margins above 60% and EBITDA margins above 30%.

Concall highlights 13 November 2026 CMP*: ₹2,400/- Sector – Book Profit Laurus Labs Ltd – Q2FY27 3 Result Update Q2FY27 Laurus Labs Ltd Management remains positive on the medium-term growth outlook, supported by strong demand from existing customers, a healthy late-stage CDMO pipeline, increasing commercial supplies and ramp-up of new capacities.
